title: Paradise Garden Hale | KEY.co
description_expanded: Fantastic experience! This was our first time travelling with an infant so having the extra bedroom was a must. High chair, pack n play, and audio monitors made the place feel as convenient as home. The home itself was well decorated and had every modern convenience you could think of. Beds were comfortable, kitchen was functional, and the garage had every possible beach supply you could want (wagon, snorkelling equipment, bikes, inflatables, coolers etc.). Location was excellent as well. 2 min drive to main shopping area that had nice grocery store and restaurants. 2 min drive to fairmont hotel for more nice restaurants. Access to beach club was great for beach days. Pool was a two minute walk away and always had ample space. Our flight was at 9:30 pm so we made arrangements for a late check out. Hosts were flexible and accommodating - which made a hectic travel day with an infant that much smoother. Overall amazing experience - will for sure book again with these hosts!
